instagram:
Customer ne Google par aapko dhundha, website kholi aur padha: 'Hum best quality dete hain'. Koi review nahi, koi photo nahi. Usne skip kar diya. 😬

Website par aane wala zyada tar insaan aapko jaanta nahi. Woh daavon par nahi, saboot par bharosa karta hai. Yehi saboot social proof hai.

Ek CA firm ki website par bas services ki list aur ek stock photo thi. Client ki permission se teen chhote case studies daale, jaise 'GST notice aaya tha, humne aise suljhaya.' Ab visitor ko bharosa milta hai.

Is reel mein:
✅ Asli reviews, naam aur shehar ke saath
✅ Kaam ki asli photos, pehle aur baad wali
✅ Chhote case studies: problem, kaam, result
✅ Proof homepage aur enquiry button ke paas, alag page par nahi

Test: apni website kholiye aur dekhiye, kya ek bhi asli saboot pehle scroll mein dikhta hai?

Aapke paas kaun sa proof hai jo website par abhi nahi dikhta? Comment mein batao 👇

🌐 webeventuals.com
